## Scope

- The PR changes only the MCP `edit_operation` refusal text, its tests, one skill row and one decision file.
- It does not change posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation or geometry. This is not a safety-tier review.
- It does not change UI, posts, goldens, `testdata/` or import code. No screenshots, example catalog suites or extra importer suites are necessary.

## What looks good

- The flat edit path does not change. The new code runs only in the `map_err` arm of `patched`. A refused call stays refused.
- A corrected call is given only when all of these are true:
  - the patch has exactly one outer key;
  - that key is the operation's own kind;
  - its value is an object;
  - the inner patch passes `patched`;
  - the inner patch passes `EditOperationParams::with_named_entry`.
- `EditOperationParams::with_named_entry` takes `&World` and runs only read-only gates (`crates/app/src/commands/operation/edit.rs:98-143`). The history does not execute the candidate command, so the refusal does not change the job or the undo stack. The tests confirm this with `get_job` equality and a redo entry that is kept.
- The suggestion uses the requested display name, as JSON. The test covers quotes and a backslash in the name.
- There is no `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!` in the source change.
- The PR edits `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`, a process file. The body has `Process change: yes`. The PR does not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`.
- The body has a `Changelog:` line and ends with `Fixes #3476`. The commit subjects are conventional. The decision file is `docs/decisions/3476-nested-params-guidance.md`.
- The tests are in the existing `mcp_enum_patch` binary. The PR adds no new test binary.

## Results, merged with main (local)

The trial merge is the PR head `a22cd58fa` merged with upstream/main `2394b5ad1`. The merge was clean. All runs were local on macOS.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 27 steps, 0 failed. The steps were the app build, the app lib and 25 app suites, including `mcp_enum_patch` (6 tests).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp_doc_drift`: 9 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Extra suites run: `mcp_doc_drift`, because the diff changes the MCP skill row. No `testdata/` or importer path changed, so no kernel suites were necessary.

Heavy and light lanes: not run. The diff is a refusal string in the MCP layer and does not reach toolpath or post output. Under AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review", these lanes are not a merge condition. The author reports a green light lane on this head.

## Mutations (local, restored after each run)

1. The one-outer-key guard (`.filter(|p| p.len() == 1)`) changed to always true: `invalid_kind_wrappers_and_unknown_fields_remain_refused` went red. Restored: green.
2. The `EditOperationParams::with_named_entry` check disabled (`if false && ...`): `invalid_kind_wrappers_and_unknown_fields_remain_refused` went red. Restored: green.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Notes (not blocking)

- `crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs` grows from 427 to 442 lines. The file was already over the 400-line limit on main. A later split along the add/edit seam is possible.
- The body says that the PR must not merge during the current merge freeze. The merge time stays the maintainer's decision.
